in_hindi.long_meaning: Nickname or short form of Hastshiv, which means 'lord of the hand' or 'master of the hand'

in_marathi.name: Hasti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hasti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Hasti refers to the elephant-headed god, Ganesha. This name symbolizes strength, wisdom, and removal of obstacles.

in_bengali.name: Hasti
